run_RealMain: run the upload.py RealMain function to upload diffs from a VCS to the codereview server
run_GuessVCS: run the GuessVCS function to auto-detect whether the current directory uses Git, Mercurial, or Subversion
run_SplitPatch: run the SplitPatch function to split an svn diff string into per-file patch tuples
run_EncodeMultipartFormData: run the EncodeMultipartFormData function to encode form fields and files into multipart form-data for HTTP upload
run_RunShellWithReturnCode: run the RunShellWithReturnCode function to execute a shell command and capture its stdout output and return code
